messages:
alex: heads up — we started the keystore rotation in us-west-2 ~5m ago, seeing some GPU nodes fail to complete bootstrap. tagging infra and platform. :eyes:

devops-bot: ALERT: node-03f failed to decrypt keystore at 2026-03-21T15:22:14Z. Autoprovision status: JOIN_PENDING. https://internal.ops/alerts/12345

sana: is this a KMS key id swap or a role boundary change? saw a couple of firewall rule updates earlier from the onboarding playbook.

lee: logs from node-03f:```
ERROR: failed to fetch ephemeral secret: KMS.DecryptAccessDenied: Access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abc-rot-2026
bootstrap: retrying in 10s
```

marcos: ops ran a scoped policy change on the privatelink keystore endpoint at 15:19 — added a condition to reject requests without `x-org-tag`. probably tightened to meet audit; might be blocking service-role requests from the GPU fleet. snippet:```
{
  "Effect":"Deny",
  "Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/x-org-tag":"redwood-prod"}}
}
```

alex: ah that explains it. those GPU nodes use an autoscaler IAM role which doesn't tag requests. can we temporarily relax the condition? we need them to join asap.

sana: i created a quick rollback: removed the deny-by-tag condition from the keystore policy and pushed it to prod via `infra-cli apply keystore/policy --env us-west-2 --pr 4221` — waiting for deploy. :hourglass_flowing_sand: would prefer a short-lived exception vs full revert if possible.

lee: running repro against staging with the same role — confirmed same DecryptAccessDenied. after rollback attempt, here's the node join tail:```
INFO: decrypted ephemeral secret for node-03f
INFO: kv cache warmup complete
INFO: node-03f: joined pool 'gpu-pool-usw2' (capacity +1)
```

marcos: cost note — we currently have ~18 nodes stuck in PENDING for ~12m. billing shows reserved instance billing as active, estimated incremental cost if not resolved within 1h ~ $2.3k (GPU-hour). tagging finance for visibility.

alex: good catch. can we also add a short-term mitigation in bootstrap that retries via the fallback keystore key (org-managed key id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/fallback-2024)? small code patch then hotpatch node image?

sana: i can push a 1-line bootstrap change to try fallback key if primary fails, but that will take ~20-30m to build/publish AMI. quicker path is policy rollback which is in flight.

lee: for immediate relief i ran `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain` on the stuck nodes and then triggered autoscaler join. manual rejoin is in progress. commands:```
for n in $(cat stuck-nodes.txt); do kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data; done
```

marcos: created ticket INFRA-824 to follow up: add request-tag on autoscaler role or inject tag in keystore client; long term either role should include `x-org-tag` or keystore policy should accept role-bound calls.

devops-bot: PR merged: rollback-keystore-tag-condition (PR #4221) — deploy started to us-west-2 by sana. CI: green. :rocket:

sana: rollback deployed — nodes are now rejoining. monitoring shows join rate back to normal. sample status:```
POOL gpu-pool-usw2: desired 40 available 40 warming 0
node-03f: ready
node-04a: ready
```

lee: confirmed GPU roster back to expected capacity. will keep an eye on ephemeral decrypt errors in the next 30m.

alex: thanks everyone — follow-ups: MARCOS to own INFRA-824, SANA to add short runbook steps for timed rotations and prewarm window, LEE to add an alert that correlates KMS.DecryptAccessDenied + node JOIN_PENDING. :heavy_check_mark:

marcos: acknowledge — will add runbook section and propose policy change that allows trust via `sts:AssumeRole` with tag injection.

sana: i'll schedule a dry-run of keystore rotation for staging with the autoscaler role pre-tagging test next week.

lee: logging note: add the exact failed KMS key id and node id to the alert payload so we can triage faster. created alert PR.

alex: closing this thread once monitoring is green for 30m. great teamwork. :thumbsup:
